official_sources.source_model_class: GPerturb_Gaussian (uppercase G; do not accidentally use the distinct later GPerturb_gaussian class)

source_audit.finding: Gaussian model is a native continuous-response sparse perturbation regression model; main eligible arm for the existing log-mean-difference ranking task. ZIP is a separate count-scale model and cannot be treated as a numerical replacement without its own endpoint mapping.
source_audit.evidence: Paper model overview; GPerturb_model.py classes GPerturb_Gaussian and GPerturb_ZIP.

source_audit.finding: Official T-cell example has hidden width 700, four hidden layers in each network, tau=1 and a commented 200-epoch fit. Replogle Gaussian uses width 1000, four layers, learning rate 0.001, 200 epochs. README demonstration uses 250 epochs.
source_audit.evidence: numerical_examples/TCells_GPerturb.py lines 46-61; numerical_examples/Replogle_GPerturb.py lines 132-157; README.md training example.

source_audit.finding: Native Gaussian loss combines scaled stochastic Gaussian log likelihood, three GP prior penalties and a basal-function penalty. Kernel matrices use the unique perturbation conditions in the current call.

Training has Adam, batch size 100, random 1/8 validation holdout and full validation tensor evaluation each epoch; assigning test_id beforehand does not fix its split because GPerturb_train overwrites it.

No native early stopping, checkpoint selection or convergence certificate exists in this helper. Gaussian training loss arrays are local and not returned. The test argument does not suppress random Gaussian/Gumbel sampling.
source_audit.evidence: GPerturb_model.py lines 91-149 and 151-193; AST inspection found no return statement in uppercase Gaussian GPerturb_train.

source_audit.finding: Naively splitting full validation normal_loss into batches changes the unique-condition GP penalty. Such a change must not be represented as an exact reproduction of the native validation objective.

Official examples expose both mu times sigmoid(logit_p) and mu times indicator(sigmoid(logit_p)>0.5). These are native plug-in readouts; sigmoid(E logit) is not claimed to equal the fully integrated inclusion probability.
source_audit.evidence: TCells_GPerturb.py lines 90-96; Replogle_GPerturb.py Gaussian prediction section.

source_audit.finding: The T-cell example loads a preprocessed CSV whose filename contains raw; it does not independently document how that CSV was normalized. We therefore cannot claim its original T-cell preprocessing has been exactly reproduced from the notebook alone.
source_audit.evidence: TCells_GPerturb.py lines 27-30. Replogle Gaussian explicitly applies log1p to counts divided by a scale factor.

proposed_protocol.entry_gate: Completed and verified D4 Rest+Stim native FR/ASH comparison; then primary owner may authorize the resource pilot under the existing staged plan. No training was started by this feasibility work.

native_model_and_inputs.class: GPerturb_Gaussian from the pinned official module; model forward and normal_loss unchanged
native_model_and_inputs.expression: FP32 log1p(raw_count * fixed task normalization_scale / raw cell_total); no per-gene centering, z-scoring or effect shrinkage before GP training. This is a documented dataset-specific continuous-input adapter, not a claim of byte-identical original T-cell CSV preprocessing.
native_model_and_inputs.cells: Exactly each frozen 20-cell target input and its 2,000 non-targeting controls. D3 rep0 development; D4 five Rest plus five Stim repetitions. No planning/reference cells enter fitting.
native_model_and_inputs.genes: All genes positive in at least one of the locked input/control cells, determined without reference expression; retain every query. Missing query is an eligibility failure, never silently imputed. Preserve all 1,200 D3 candidates and all 300 responsive queries for formal selection.
native_model_and_inputs.perturbation_design: One-hot column per target; non-targeting controls represented by the all-zero vector; guide identities merged exactly as in the pooled task.
native_model_and_inputs.basal_covariates: log(total UMI), detected-feature count divided by total UMI, mitochondrial UMI fraction, and lane one-hot coding (drop one lane). All computed from the exact same input cells or metadata. Donor/state constants omitted because fits are separate. Record definitions and units, no learned embedding or post-treatment response score.
native_model_and_inputs.missing_covariates_rule: Recover metadata only for already allowed donor/state cells. If mitochondrial gene annotation or lane identities cannot be validated, stop this native-example-matched arm or prespecify and label a reduced-covariate sensitivity before fitting; do not silently replace them with zeros.
native_model_and_inputs.precision_and_packages: Native FP32; torch 2.2.2, numpy 1.26.4, pandas 2.2.1, matplotlib 3.8.0; record Python and BLAS. CPU threads=8, interop=1; serial fits only.

D3_only_search.selection: Among eligible converged fits, maximize the existing D3 rep0 bidirectional P@25 for the selected native readout; exact 1e-12 ties prefer width700/lr0.001 then table order, then continuous readout. Retain every grid result and any unavailable configuration. Selection is strongest in this finite declared grid, not universally strongest GPerturb.
D3_only_search.historical_budget_caveat: At most four fit configurations and eight readout combinations; this is below the FR 21-setting count. Equal setting count is not claimed to imply equal computational or historical tuning effort.
D3_only_search.split: Seeded random 1/8 holdout from the existing shallow input cells only, matching the official helper convention; save explicit train/validation IDs and per-target counts. D3 validation never includes deep-reference cells.
D3_only_search.validation_then_full_input_refit: Use D3 holdout solely to choose an epoch budget and assess convergence. Refit the selected configuration from scratch on all shallow cells for that fixed epoch budget; formal comparison therefore does not discard a fraction of the 20-cell input. Clearly disclose this checkpoint/refit wrapper as an execution adapter.

loss_monitoring_and_convergence.wrapper: Expose native loss history, checkpoint model/optimizer/RNG every 5 epochs, explicit train/validation indices, and monitor without changing the model or normal_loss formula. Do not call GPerturb_train separately for each epoch because it re-splits data and resets Adam.
loss_monitoring_and_convergence.implementation_gate: On a small fixed synthetic batch, compare the wrapper and official normal_loss gradients and one Adam update with identical initial tensors and RNG; tolerance 1e-6 relative / 1e-7 absolute. Input and output shape/zero-condition identity must pass. This is an implementation check, not a biological result.
loss_monitoring_and_convergence.validation_objective: Unchanged normal_loss on the complete frozen validation subset. Every 10 epochs, use four fixed common random draws with RNG state restoration and divide the resulting objective by fixed data_size for a comparable scale. Preserve individual draws. This is a stochastic native objective, not an independent predictive-likelihood certificate.
loss_monitoring_and_convergence.early_stop_rule: No stop before epoch250. At each 10-epoch check thereafter, require (i) no validation-objective improvement greater than 0.1% of max(1,abs(best normalized objective)) over the previous 50 epochs; (ii) the native continuous perturbation readout on the fixed 1,200-by-300 output axis changes by relative Frobenius norm <=1% between the last two checkpoints 25 epochs apart (if both norms <1e-6, require absolute RMS <=1e-6); (iii) finite outputs, finite native loss and gradients throughout. Use the earliest eligible epoch as the fixed refit budget. These are operational stability criteria, not proof of variational global convergence.
loss_monitoring_and_convergence.post_refit_stability: The full-input refit must also satisfy finite outputs and the same 25-epoch output-stability criterion at its final epoch. A failed refit is incomplete; do not select an earlier reference-favorable checkpoint.
loss_monitoring_and_convergence.seed_sensitivity: Repeat the selected configuration with two additional predeclared seeds. All three outputs are reported; no best-seed selection. Disagreement must widen interpretation even if each fit passes its operational stop rule.

smoke.scope: Synthetic implementation equivalence, package/device check, no candidate ranking or reference access.

resource_pilot.scope: Exact full D3 tensor shapes, at least 20 native training batches and one full validation call for each architecture that can fit; no deep-reference scoring. Extrapolate epoch and 250/500-epoch costs; record peak RSS/cgroup memory and observed batch variance. If even one full validation call exceeds the budget, classify unqualified, not defeated.

staged_budget.memory_stop_note: Cooperative RSS/cgroup monitor with margin under the 8 GiB cgroup limit; release allocations and save failure log. Never test OOM by killing other experiments.
staged_budget.budget_accounting: Separate environment/implementation/pilot time from training. Count every restart and failed job; checkpoint resumptions count toward the same fit budget. Serial runs under heavy_memory.lock. The caps are resource allocations, not assertions that convergence will occur.
staged_budget.pilot_continue_rule: Complete memory-safe native full validation and projected 250-epoch fit within 12 hours. If the 500-epoch projection exceeds12h, retain budget-exhaustion as a possible outcome; do not lower minimum epochs or change architecture after seeing performance.
staged_budget.strongest_grid_claim_rule: If width1000 cannot be completed, the valid width700 arm may be reported explicitly, but no claim of beating the strongest declared GPerturb grid is allowed. No smaller candidate pool or query-only training is substituted into the primary task.
staged_budget.hardware_fallback: If the full native helper cannot satisfy the memory/time gate, request a suitable dedicated machine (suggested starting allocation: >=32 GiB host RAM and >=16 GiB GPU VRAM, then repeat the same measurement gate). This is an engineering starting point, not a validated minimum.

D4_transfer.lock_before_GP_D4_scores: Archive exact source hashes, package lock, selected architecture/lr/readout, epoch budget, preprocessing rules, seeds and data identities after D3; no D4 retuning.
D4_transfer.fit: Train from scratch independently on each D4 input repetition using the locked hyperparameters and fixed D3 epoch count, with all20 shallow cells per target and the same2,000 controls; no model trained across repetitions or states.
D4_transfer.stability: Track native loss and final-output stability without reference access. If a repetition fails the locked stability/resource criteria, mark the method incomplete for the pooled primary comparison. Do not selectively omit that repetition.
D4_transfer.score: Only complete locked outputs enter the unchanged six-arm task scorer adapted with a native GP output arm; compare raw, Euclidean, PertRank and GP on identical candidates/queries/reference. Report P25 primary, P10 sensitivity and paired query-block uncertainty; cells/donor interpretation as in original protocol.
D4_transfer.D1_D2_Stim: Remain unopened. GP feasibility does not authorize expression access or substitute for registration/lock checks.

failure_taxonomy: NUMERICAL_FAILURE: nonfinite output/loss/gradient or singular GP solve; log exact state, no outcome-driven solver substitution.
RESOURCE_BLOCKED: full-shape pilot exceeds memory or time; no performance score.
BUDGET_EXHAUSTED_UNCONVERGED: reaches time/epoch ceiling without stability; no claim that PertRank outperforms a sufficiently trained GPerturb.
COMPLETE_ELIGIBLE: finite, aligned, operationally stable and within the locked protocol; may score, including a legitimate low or zero effect estimate.
forbidden_shortcuts: Using unavailable GPU or uninstalled torch as a negative benchmark result.
Training only the300 query genes or reducing the candidate pool to make a nominal full-task GP arm fit.
Treating naive batched validation ELBO as identical to the full native loss.
Passing a fixed test_id to native GPerturb_train and assuming the split is retained.
Resetting Adam each epoch or repeatedly calling GPerturb_train to fake checkpointed continuation.
Using pretrained models that may have seen the reference data.
